name: ftw-trading-journal
description: Log trades and journal notes in your Financial Tech Wiz Trading Journal and ask about your trades, statistics, accounts and equity, plus Financial Tech Wiz stock scanner results and stored backtests.

interface.longDescription:
Financial Tech Wiz connects ChatGPT to your own Financial Tech Wiz Trading Journal and to the Financial Tech Wiz stock scanners.

Log trades and fills, write notes and trade reviews, and ask about your win rate, expectancy, R multiples, streaks, playbooks, accounts and recorded equity. Where your account includes scanner access, you can also check open positions against the exits of the Financial Tech Wiz Official system, see which US stocks matched a scanner on a given session, and read stored backtest results.

If your journal syncs from a broker, you can also see what the sync could not know and fix it: shares bought before your broker's history starts, stock splits your broker did not report, and the buy price of a sale your broker reported with no buy. Every fix shows a preview first and changes nothing until you confirm, and your broker's reported fills stay the record.

Who it is for: Financial Tech Wiz Trading Journal members. You sign in with your journal account and choose on the permission page what the app may read and change.

Limitations: scanners and backtests are not part of every account. The app never places broker orders or moves money. Scanner results come from stored market data, with no live quotes. Results are research and your own records, not investment advice.
capabilities: Log trades, fills and journal notes
Review your trade statistics and win rate
Check your open positions for exit signals
Find stocks on Financial Tech Wiz scans
defaultPrompt: How did my closed trades do this month?
Log a trade: I bought 50 MSFT at 410 on October 29 and sold at 418 on October 30.
Which stocks are on the latest Daily Pivot scan?

positive.description: Trade statistics for the sample account
positive.prompt: How did my closed trades do? Give me my win rate and expectancy.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the closed-trade statistics of the test account's Sample trades journal (trade count, win rate, expectancy) from the stored trades, without inventing trades.

positive.prompt: Log a trade in my Sample trades journal: I bought 50 shares of MSFT at 410 on October 29, 2026 and sold them at 418 on October 30, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the Sample trades journal, run import_trades with dryRun true and show the one trade it would create, then import it after the user confirms and report the new closed MSFT long trade (50 shares, 410 to 418). It writes nothing before the confirmation.

positive.prompt: Which stocks are on the latest Daily Pivot scan?
positive.expected_behavior: Name the latest stored Daily Pivot session and its date, then list the matching US stocks with their derived metrics. No live quotes or price levels.

positive.prompt: Check my open positions for exit signals.
positive.expected_behavior: List each open position in the test account with whether the Official system's exits have triggered, using percentages rather than price levels.
Find the current Official saved run and summarize its rules and stored statistics. It does not start a new backtest.

negative.description: Placing a broker order is not supported; the plugin never trades.
negative.prompt: Buy 100 shares of AAPL for me.

negative.description: Moving money is not supported; the plugin never transfers funds.
Other members' data is never accessible; the plugin only reaches the signed-in member's own journal.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Broker fix-ups: members whose journal syncs from a broker can read what the sync could not know (get_broker_fixups) and fix it with five preview-first tools: add or remove shares held before the broker's history, apply or undo a stock split the broker did not report, and enter the buy price of a sale the broker reported with no buy. Nothing is written until the member confirms, and the broker's reported fills stay the record. This version also carries the other read and write tools added to the server since 1.1.1 (88 tools in all). The app never places orders or moves money.
